caption: The drawing depicts a metallic door handle and keyhole assembly mounted on a shield-shaped backplate. The handle is cylindrical with a rounded knob midway and a smaller spherical end, all shaded in varying tones of gray and brown, suggesting a worn and slightly tarnished metal. The backplate is vertically oriented with a pointed bottom and rounded top, textured to represent aged or distressed metal. It has three flat-head screws, one near the top, one in the middle, and one at the bottom, securing it in place. The keyhole is positioned centrally on the lower half of the backplate, shaped with a round upper section and a narrow lower slit. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or features present. The overall composition is straightforward, with the objects centrally aligned and depicted in a realistic style.
title: Metal Door Lock
